# Frozen compatibility oracles

These JSON files are the byte-identical historical compatibility oracles previously stored in `skills/herdr-soho/scripts/test/golden`. They were copied from the operator-approved dirty source baseline at commit `dd40b5a` during the Go-only migration; the adjacent SHA256SUMS records the exact copied bytes. Their original generators are retired with the JavaScript engine. They are data consumed by native Go tests and require no JavaScript runtime.

`setuptext.json` retains the exact original `internal/setuptext/testdata/setuptext.json` bytes. Cursor trust transcripts under `fixtures/` retain the original full, clipped and answered dialog fixtures. Their hashes are also recorded in SHA256SUMS; relocating them does not regenerate their expectations.

Do not regenerate these files from the Go implementation simply to obtain passing tests. Intentional behavior changes need explicit contract assertions or a documented narrow normalization in the consumer, preserving unrelated golden expectations. Historical shell hook strings are inert migration fixtures, never commands executed by these tests. The original source archive and migration reports record provenance and adapted contracts. `retired-sources.sha256` records the exact retired implementation, launcher, installer, test and generator bytes; these files are no longer runnable project tools. Generated Unicode tables and package-level JSON corpora remain frozen independently of the native implementation. The generated-source header names the historical generator as provenance, not as a command to run.
